name: cf_dns_sync_standard_cnames
description: Verifica CNAMEs estandar de autamedica.com en Cloudflare (admin, companies, doctors, patients)

steps.description: Cerrar el centro de preferencias/cookies si aparece

args.script: (async () => { const labels = ['allow all', 'close preference center', 'aceptar', 'allow']; const findButton = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('button,[role="button"],a')].find((el) => { const text = (el.innerText || el.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase(); return labels.some((label) => text.includes(label)); }); const button = findButton(); if (button) { button.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 750)); return 'cookie preferences dismissed'; } return 'cookie preferences not present'; })()

steps.description: Asegurar que no estamos en login y que la tabla DNS esta lista

args.script: (async () => { const start = Date.now(); while (Date.now() - start < 15000) { const text = (document.body.innerText || '').toLowerCase(); const hasLogin = text.includes('iniciar sesión en cloudflare') || !!document.querySelector('input[type="email"], input[name="email"]'); if (hasLogin) { throw new Error('Cloudflare login required in persistent profile'); } const dnsReady = text.includes('agregar registro') || text.includes('add record') || text.includes('dns records') || text.includes('records'); if (dnsReady) { return 'dns page ready'; } await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); } throw new Error('DNS page not ready for verification'); })()

steps.description: Validar admin, companies, doctors y patients con sus targets pages.dev

args.script: (async () => { const required = ['admin','autamedica-admin.pages.dev','companies','autamedica-companies.pages.dev','doctors','autamedica-doctors.pages.dev','patients','autamedica-patients.pages.dev']; const start = Date.now(); while (Date.now() - start < 20000) { const t = (document.body.innerText || '').toLowerCase(); const hasLogin = t.includes('iniciar sesión en cloudflare') || !!document.querySelector('input[type="email"], input[name="email"]'); if (hasLogin) { throw new Error('Cloudflare login required in persistent profile'); } const missing = required.filter(x => !t.includes(x)); if (!missing.length) { return 'all standard cnames present'; } await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); } throw new Error('Missing required DNS entries in visible page text'); })()
